SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_code AS policyCode, policy_name AS policyName, min_days_before AS minDaysBefore, max_days_before AS maxDaysBefore, fee_rate AS feeRate, editable_yn AS editableYn, display_order AS displayOrder FROM REFUND_POLICY WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_code AS policyCode, policy_name AS policyName, min_days_before AS minDaysBefore, max_days_before AS maxDaysBefore, fee_rate AS feeRate, editable_yn AS editableYn, display_order AS displayOrder FROM REFUND_POLICY WHERE min_days_before <= #{daysBefore} AND ( max_days_before IS NULL OR max_days_before >= #{daysBefore} ) ORDER BY display_order FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
